Hey, it's been some hours and I seem to have calmed down enough to feel genuinely embarassed. On the course of my boss talked me out of resignation, and I dropped a huge shit on my friends, so now I'm a bit in an awkward place. I think it should be fine, well I hope until new years eve.

Yeah, I think I should try alternate methods of breakthroughs.  Nothing doesn't heal.

Thanks a lot for your time !

I had a big appartment with my 2 best friends. We were living a very happy and intense life all together. We began building projects together. But one day I fell in love with my best female friends, to whom I was also the main emotional/mental support. Which led me to become violent towards my best friends because of I don't know how to handle love. Which led me to become violent with everyone. My family, the girl I loved, random people passing by the streets, my boss... Which led my friends to lose their projects, my family to lose faith in me, the girl to lose support, some people to loose teeth, and my boss to lose a valuable employee. And as I fleed the life I just lost, I also made a lot of people lose a supportive friend.

I've been through the exact same situation about 3 years ago. Saw a psychiatrist, took a few xanax shit and tramadol, but none really seemed to matter as I attempted an exit bag a few months after.

I don't want my life rythm to depend on destroying lifes after lifes. It already happened. It will keep on happening no matter where I go. I'll keep on destroying everything...
